steps.label: probe2
steps.run: cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/esp/"* . && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P probe2.py > bl.log 2>&1; grep -a 'PROBE2 DONE' bl.log || tail -20 bl.log; a="probe2.json esp/probe2.json"; for f in p2/*.jpg; do a="$a $f esp/p2/$(basename $f)"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2
